name: loader-prism
title: Prism loader
description: A ray of light crosses a wireframe prism and comes out as a fan of three colors, each landing on a screen as a band; the prism sways and the bands sweep. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-overprint
title: Overprint loader
description: Three print plates, each a square in its own color, slide in from three sides and settle into register, their tints overlapping into one; the registration mark flashes in the accent, and the plates drift apart again. One of the Youj loaders: a polite status with one API (size, color, speed, label, paused), drawn on a shared ticker only while it’s on screen; reduced motion holds a still frame.

name: loader-spectrum
title: Spectrum loader
description: An isometric grid of the brand’s square particles, a gradient sliding through it once a loop: each square lifts and passes from the ink through two colors and back, the accent corner leading.
